verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any first-party bulk-operation feature, such as selecting many projects, files, users or records and acting on them in one step. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: a SQL editor for direct database access (a developer building block), workspace-level skills reused across projects (configuration reuse, not a bulk action), an MCP server an external agent could script against (a building block), and multi-project tabs (UI navigation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
